paper.title_en: Holographic Tessellations Tensor Networks $\{p,q\}$ from Entangled Quantum Tetrahedron in Loop Quantum Gravity
paper.abstract_en: The relationship between spin network states in loop quantum gravity and bulk--boundary duality is further explored using the tessellated holographic tensor network. We develop a holographic tensor network construction based on quantum entanglement between tetrahedra in loop quantum gravity (LQG). This construction relates four-valent intertwiner spaces and Bell states dressed with $SU(2)$ holonomies to effective tensors on hyperbolic $\{p,q\}$ tessellations. For the $\{5,4\}$ tessellation, six tetrahedra are assembled into a single effective cell with five network legs and one logical index. Provided that the microscopic transfer map has full row rank, a right inverse and a completion on the kernel space are employed to construct an isometric embedding, yielding an effective tensor proportional to a perfect tensor. The construction is generalized to the $p=2n-1$ family, with local dimensions supporting absolutely maximally entangled states. On finite networks satisfying a radial orientation condition, an appropriate normalization produces an isometric bulk--boundary map. For cuts satisfying the isometry condition on both sides, the boundary entropy decomposes into a link contribution $\sum_{\ell}\log(2j_{\ell}+1)$ and the bulk entropy, thereby providing a discrete realization of the quantum Ryu--Takayanagi structure. Applications to the black hole interior are formulated via postselection-based non-isometric encoding. Assuming additional Haar statistics, this framework is used to analyze the preservation of overlaps on average and the competition between entropy branches underlying the Page Curve. These results establish a constructive link between the geometric degrees of freedom of LQG and holographic codes, while clarifying the conditions required to connect them to geometric area in LQG, the location of the quantum extremal surface, and evaporation of black hole.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在圈量子引力自旋网络与全息张量网络之间构造了明确联系，推导了离散的量子 Ryu-Takayanagi 熵分解，并讨论了黑洞内部与 Page 曲线的应用；理论深度高且结构清晰，属于引力学基础与全息对偶方向的实质性研究，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 来自圈量子引力中纠缠量子四面体的全息镶嵌张量网络 $\{p,q\}$
decision.abstract_zh: 本文利用镶嵌全息张量网络，进一步探讨了圈量子引力中的自旋网络态与体-边对偶之间的关系。我们基于圈量子引力（LQG）中四面体之间的量子纠缠，发展了一种全息张量网络构造。该构造将四价交错子空间以及由 $SU(2)$ 完整移动（holonomy）修饰的 Bell 态，与双曲 $\{p,q\}$ 镶嵌上的有效张量联系起来。对于 $\{5,4\}$ 镶嵌，六个四面体被组合成一个具有五个网络腿和一个逻辑指标的有效单元。假定微观转移映射具有满行秩，则利用一个右逆以及在核空间上的补全来构造等距嵌入，从而产生一个与完美张量成比例的有效张量。该构造被推广到 $p=2n-1$ 族，其局域维数支持绝对最大纠缠态。在满足径向取向条件的有限网络上，适当的归一化产生一个等距的体-边映射。对于两侧均满足等距条件的割，边界熵分解为连边贡献 $\sum_{\ell}\log(2j_{\ell}+1)$ 与体熵，从而提供了量子 Ryu--Takayanagi 结构的一种离散实现。对黑洞内部的应用通过基于后选择的非等距编码来表述。在假定额外的 Haar 统计的情况下，该框架被用于分析平均意义上重叠的保持情况，以及 Page 曲线背后熵分支之间的竞争。这些结果在 LQG 的几何自由度与全息码之间建立了建设性联系，同时阐明了将它们与 LQG 中的几何面积、量子极值面的位置以及黑洞蒸发相联系所需的条件。
